terminal.none: spec requires 'alternating turns or equivalent lifecycle', which checkTurnEnd implements; no victory or defeat condition is required of this experiment

content.text: Arrows move  Enter select/act  B back

scripts.init:
local v = ctx.v
v.gridWidth = 6
v.gridHeight = 6

-- State: 'idle', 'selecting_move'
v.state = 'idle'
v.statusText = "Player Turn - Select Unit"

-- Units: {x, y, team, hp, max_hp, moved_this_turn}
-- team 1 = player, team 2 = enemy
v.units = {
    {id=1, x=1, y=4, team=1, hp=10, max_hp=10, symbol='A', moved_this_turn=false},
    {id=2, x=2, y=5, team=1, hp=8, max_hp=8, symbol='B', moved_this_turn=false},
    {id=3, x=4, y=1, team=2, hp=12, max_hp=12, symbol='E', moved_this_turn=false},
    {id=4, x=3, y=0, team=2, hp=9, max_hp=9, symbol='F', moved_this_turn=false}
}

v.cx = 1
v.cy = 4
v.selected_unit = 0

local function drawBoard()
    local lines = {}
    for y = 0, v.gridHeight - 1 do
        local row = ""
        for x = 0, v.gridWidth - 1 do
            local char = "."
            
            -- check for units
            for _, u in ipairs(v.units) do
                if u.hp > 0 and u.x == x and u.y == y then
                    char = u.symbol
                    if u.moved_this_turn then
                        char = string.lower(char)
                    end
                end
            end
            
            if x == v.cx and y == v.cy then
                row = row .. "[" .. char .. "]"
            else
                row = row .. " " .. char .. " "
            end
        end
        table.insert(lines, row)
    end
    v.boardText = table.concat(lines, "\n")
end
drawBoard()
v.drawBoard = drawBoard
scripts.move_cursor:
local v = ctx.v
local nx = v.cx + v.dx
local ny = v.cy + v.dy

if nx >= 0 and nx < v.gridWidth and ny >= 0 and ny < v.gridHeight then
    v.cx = nx
    v.cy = ny
end

v.drawBoard()
scripts.action:
local v = ctx.v

local function getUnitAt(x, y)
    for _, u in ipairs(v.units) do
        if u.hp > 0 and u.x == x and u.y == y then return u end
    end
    return nil
end

local function checkTurnEnd()
    local all_moved = true
    for _, u in ipairs(v.units) do
        if u.hp > 0 and u.team == 1 and not u.moved_this_turn then
            all_moved = false
            break
        end
    end
    
    if all_moved then
        for _, u in ipairs(v.units) do u.moved_this_turn = false end
        v.statusText = "Enemy Turn (Simulated) -> Player Turn"
        -- simple enemy turn simulation: just heal 1 HP
        for _, u in ipairs(v.units) do
            if u.hp > 0 and u.team == 2 and u.hp < u.max_hp then
                u.hp = u.hp + 1
            end
        end
    end
end

if v.state == 'idle' then
    local u = getUnitAt(v.cx, v.cy)
    if u and u.team == 1 and not u.moved_this_turn then
        v.selected_unit = u.id
        v.state = 'selecting_move'
        v.statusText = "Moving " .. u.symbol .. " (Select destination)"
    end
elseif v.state == 'selecting_move' then
    -- find selected unit
    local su = nil
    for _, u in ipairs(v.units) do
        if u.id == v.selected_unit then su = u; break end
    end
    
    if su then
        -- check distance
        local dist = math.abs(su.x - v.cx) + math.abs(su.y - v.cy)
        local target_u = getUnitAt(v.cx, v.cy)
        
        if dist <= 2 and not target_u then
            -- Move
            su.x = v.cx
            su.y = v.cy
            su.moved_this_turn = true
            v.state = 'idle'
            v.statusText = "Moved " .. su.symbol
            checkTurnEnd()
        elseif dist == 1 and target_u and target_u.team == 2 then
            -- Attack
            target_u.hp = target_u.hp - 3
            su.moved_this_turn = true
            v.state = 'idle'
            v.statusText = "Attacked " .. target_u.symbol .. "!"
            if target_u.hp <= 0 then v.statusText = v.statusText .. " Defeated!" end
            checkTurnEnd()
        else
            v.statusText = "Invalid move! Must be range 2 or attack range 1."
        end
    end
end

v.drawBoard()
scripts.cancel_action:
local v = ctx.v
v.state = 'idle'
v.statusText = "Player Turn - Select Unit"
v.selected_unit = 0
v.drawBoard()
